narrative.details:
I fear the leadership behind the Syndicate is bent on Southshore's ruin.  We must strike hard at these leaders before their plans are realized.

Enter the ruins of Strahnbrad, in the Alterac Mountains to the north.  We think the Syndicate is using the area as a headquarters.

We know this gang of cutthroats is run by former Alterac nobles.  They may be hiding as normal Syndicate agents, but you'll know you've killed a noble by the signet ring he wears.

Bring me those signet rings.
narrative.objectives: Bring 7 Alterac Signet Rings to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Stripping the Syndicate of its nobility will remove its ability to act decisively, and reduce it to nothing more than a gang of thugs.

You serve your Alliance well, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you been hunting the Syndicate? Do you have those rings?
